name: Lexter
summary: The Lexter RO Water Purifier delivers safe and healthy drinking water with an advanced 6-stage purification system featuring RO + UV + TDS Controller + Alkaline + Copper + Zinc technologies.
intro: Lexter Water Purifier features advanced RO + UV + Zinc Alkaline + MTDS technology with 6-stage purification. It helps remove harmful contaminants, bacteria, viruses, chlorine and unpleasant odours while providing better-tasting drinking water. Suitable for municipal, borewell and tanker water with TDS up to 2,000 PPM. Includes 8 L storage, LED indicators, automatic shut-off, built-in TDS meter, and wall-mount/countertop installation.
